note: Locales the pack knows about. To add one: add an entry here, add skills/<skill>/locales/<code>/ resources for the tools that need them, and a locales/<code>.md guide for each skill. en-US keeps its original files where they always were (hooks.json, slop.json), so nothing about English moved.

speech.rate_note: Estimated articulation rate in syllables per minute, pauses added separately. Not measured on this user. Calibrate with: beats.py script.txt --locale ko-KR --calibrate SECONDS

detect.note: Auto-detection runs only when nothing explicit was set. It looks at the share of Hangul syllables among all letters.
